caption: The drawing depicts two brown leather shoes and a coiled brown shoelace set against a plain, neutral background. Both shoes are worn, with visible creases and folds in the leather, suggesting heavy use. The shoe on the left is upright and positioned to show its upper and side, while the shoe on the right is tipped over, exposing its sole, which features metal studs along the edge and some visible scuff marks. Both shoes have a few small eyelets for laces, with one greenish eyelet apparent on each shoe. The coiled brown shoelace is placed to the right of the shoes, lying flat on the background. The composition arranges the objects slightly angled towards each other, leaving ample empty space around them. The artist's name, "ARCHIE THOMPSON," is written below the drawing.
title: Shoes
